tools.name: list_reports
tools.description: List the available AppFolio reports (slug, name, category, required filters). Optionally filter by category. Use this to discover which report to run, then call describe_report for its parameters and run_report to execute it.

category.description: Optional category filter (e.g. 'Financial', 'Leasing', 'Tenant'). Omit to list every report. Call without args first to see all categories.

tools.name: describe_report
tools.description: Get the full parameter specification for a single AppFolio report: required and optional filters, types, enums, defaults, nested attributes, and response columns. Call this before run_report to know exactly which parameters to pass.

report_name.description: The report slug, e.g. 'balance_sheet' or 'rent_roll'. See list_reports.

tools.name: run_report
tools.description: Run an AppFolio report and return its rows. Validates the report name, required filters, and parameter names against the report catalog before calling AppFolio. Use describe_report first to learn the exact filter keys for the report.

report_name.description: The report slug to run, e.g. 'balance_sheet'. See list_reports / describe_report.

filters.description: Report-specific filters as a JSON object keyed by the parameter names from describe_report (e.g. { posted_on_to: '2024-12-31', properties: { properties_ids: ['123'] } }). Required filters must be included or the request is rejected.

columns.description: Optional subset of response columns to return. All columns are returned by default.

paginate_results.description: Default true (5,000 rows/page, auto-followed). Set false to return all rows as one array.

tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.description: List the available AppFolio Database API endpoints (operationId, method, path, category, description). Optionally filter by category, resource, method, or reads-only. Use this to discover which endpoint to use, then call describe_endpoint for its parameters and call_endpoint to execute it. This is the AppFolio v0 Database API (records/CRUD), distinct from the Reporting API (list_reports/run_report).

category.description: Optional category filter (e.g. 'Accounting', 'Leasing', 'People', 'Properties', 'Maintenance', 'Community Associations', 'Corporate Accounting', 'Custom Fields', 'System'). Call without args first to see all categories.

method.description: Optional HTTP method filter: GET, POST, PATCH, PUT, or DELETE.

reads_only.description: If true, return only read (GET) endpoints.

tools.name: describe_endpoint
tools.description: Get the full specification for a single AppFolio Database API endpoint: HTTP method, path and path params, query filters (GET), request body schema with nested attributes (writes), response fields, and a request sample. Call this before call_endpoint to know exactly which parameters to pass.

operation_id.description: The endpoint operationId, e.g. 'get_tenants' or 'post_bills'. See list_endpoints.

tools.name: call_endpoint
tools.description: Call an AppFolio Database API endpoint and return its JSON response. Validates the operationId and required path params against the catalog before calling AppFolio, then executes (GET reads are auto-paginated; POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE writes execute live against your AppFolio database). Use describe_endpoint first to learn the exact params and body.

operation_id.description: The endpoint operationId to call, e.g. 'get_tenants' or 'post_bills'. See list_endpoints / describe_endpoint.

path_params.description: Values for {param} placeholders in the path, e.g. { billId: '1abc...' } for /bills/{billId}.

filters.description: GET filter params keyed by filter name (the 'filters[...]' wrapper is added automatically), e.g. { LastUpdatedAtFrom: '2020-01-01T00:00:00Z', Id: 'uuid,uuid' }. Arrays are comma-joined.

query.description: Additional raw query params (rare; most filtering goes through `filters`).

body.description: JSON request body for write operations (POST/PATCH/PUT). See describe_endpoint for the schema.

page.description: Pagination for GET list endpoints: { number, size }. Default size is 1000.

paginate_results.description: GET only. Default true: follow next_page_path and aggregate all rows. Set false for a single page.
